Experience manifests (.verse.json)#

An experience is one JSON file that turns a folder of assets into a walkthrough URL: a base scene, extra GLBs placed into it, lighting, ambience, and the hotspots a buyer jumps between. The playground runs one with ?experience=<url>; the embed SDK with viewer.load("x.verse.json"). All URLs resolve against the manifest and must be same-origin (the Verse origin never feeds foreign bytes to the parsers).

Code
{
  "name": "Purvankara 3BHK",
  "scene": "ingest/purvankara-d992a4ef9b5d.vpk",
  "props": [
    { "url": "props/sofa.glb", "position": [2.1, 0, -1.4], "yaw": 90, "scale": 1 }
  ],
  "environment": "env/evening.hdr",
  "ambience": { "particles": "dust@2,1.5,-1*1", "audio": "wind@0,2,0" },
  "dof": { "focus": 3.5, "aperture": 0 },
  "exposure": 0.8,
  "spawn": { "position": [0, 1.6, 3], "yaw": 180 },
  "hotspots": [
    { "id": "kitchen", "label": "Kitchen", "position": [4, 1.6, -2], "look": [4, 1.2, -6],
      "anchor": [4, 1.0, -5.5], "title": "Kitchen", "body": "Island in **quartz**, [brochure](https://…)",
      "image": "/ingest/poster-9a1b2c3d4e.png", "link": "https://example.com/kitchen" }
  ],
  "tour": {
    "steps": [
      { "hotspot": "kitchen", "eye": [4, 1.6, -2], "look": [4, 1.2, -6], "dwell": 4,
        "narration": "The kitchen opens onto the terrace.", "audio": "/ingest/exp-38fd878a72-media-9a1b2c3d.mp3" }
    ]
  },
  "sun": { "azimuth": 150, "elevation": 30, "intensity": 3 },
  "version": 2
}
KeyMeaning
scene (required unless scenes).vpk streams through the meshlet DAG; .glb/.gltf loads whole. Loads first; everything else waits for it.
scenesup to 8 {url, position, yaw, scale} streamed objects in one experience (apartment + clubhouse). The first is the base — camera framing and the walk grid come from it; the rest stream additively at their world offsets, rotated yaw degrees about +Y. The playground's URL-knob twin is ?vpk=<base>&vpk2=url@x,y,z*yawDeg*scale;url@… — each ;-separated entry places one extra .vpk (@x,y,z offset in metres, *yawDeg rotation, *scale uniform; all optional, defaults 0,0,0 / 0 / 1).
propsUp to 64 GLBs appended to the scene after it reports in. position metres, yaw degrees about +Y, scale uniform. Props are static (their own animations, skins and morphs are ignored in v1) and do not join the walk-collision grid.
environmentAn .hdr on this origin, applied as the image-based light.
ambienceThe ?particles= / ?audio= knob strings: kind@x,y,z*scale;….
dofDepth of field: focus distance (m) and aperture (px·m, 0 = off). Tiers A/B.
exposureEV stops applied in linear space before the tonemap, clamped ±4; omitted = default look (0 EV). Authored via the editor's Exposure slider, applied on load through the same set-exposure verb as ?exposure= and the embed's setExposure(ev).
spawnWhere walk mode starts: eye position + yaw. Replaces the occupancy-derived spawn search.
startOptional, 4.0: "walk" opens the visitor standing at spawn in walk mode once the scene has loaded (generated floor-plan homes use it). Absent = the scene's own opening camera.
hotspotsUp to 64 {id, label, position, look}. A jump enters walk mode at position facing look, so the collision walk continues from there. Version 2 adds the pin and its card: anchor (the surface point the numbered pin hangs on — defaults to position), title (120 chars), body (2000 chars of plain text with **bold**, *italic* and [text](https://…) links), image (same-origin URL) and link (http/https). A hotspot with any of these renders as a pin + info card instead of the v1 button strip.
tourVersion 2: the guided tour — steps (up to 64) of {hotspot?, eye, look, dwell, narration?, audio?}. eye/look are the camera pose (defaults: the named hotspot's position/look); dwell seconds the camera rests there (0.5–60, default 4); narration text (2000 chars, same rich-text subset) and audio a same-origin clip (POST /v1/experience/<id>/media, ≤ 2 MB). Playback flies between steps at ~2 m/s (≥ 1.2 s a leg) on the engine's camera path, shows the narration per step, and leaves the walker standing at the last step. Steps whose eye cannot be resolved are dropped; an empty list reads as no tour.
sunVersion 2: {azimuth, elevation, intensity} in the engine's S5 convention (degrees; azimuth from +X toward +Z, elevation 2–90, intensity 0–20, default 2.8) — the same triple as ?sun= and the embed's setSun. Applied on load; a ?sun= knob in the link still wins because it applies after.
exterior2.7: the exterior kit's state — { sky: {on, turbidity, exposure, clouds: {coverage, density}}, weather: {kind, intensity, wind}, fog: {on, density, height, falloff, colour}, ground: {kind, size, material, y, colour, heightfield, amplitude, center} } (every field optional; the viewer fills defaults and clamps). ground.heightfield is the scene's ingest/<id>.ground.png. The Author bar writes it when "Save the exterior" is ticked; share-string knobs in the link win because they apply after.
lights2.7.2: the light studio's share string (all=1.2;env=1.5;ev=0.8;soft=3;l0=…;e3=…, see lights.js), written by Make it look good for a signed-in owner and applied with sun / exterior when the manifest mounts; a ?lights= on the link wins because it applies after.
version2 for manifests carrying the keys above; absent/1 reads exactly as before (no pins, no tour, no sun). The parser never rejects a version it does not know — unknown keys are ignored.

Runtime contract: the experience event fires when the manifest is parsed; loaded when the base scene is up; each prop that fails leaves the rest loading and reports through error. On GPU-context recovery the engine replays the base GLB and its props itself; a streamed base is re-streamed by the worker.

Authoring (2.7): the playground's ?author=1 Author bar (a signed-in Studio session; guide) writes version-2 manifests — click a surface to drop a hotspot (the pick lands anchor, the current view becomes position/look), reorder, fill the card, record a tour step per hotspot (pose from the current view, dwell, narration, audio), keep the sun — and saves through POST /v1/experience then PUT /v1/experience/<id>; "Set as link default" (PUT /v1/scenes/<id>/experience) makes the plain share link /?vpk=ingest/<id>.vpk play it. Viewers and embeds read edited manifests through GET /v1/experience/<id> (?experience=/v1/experience/<id>), never the year-immutable static copy. Studio lists a scene's experiences under Experiences.

The playground's ?edit=1 editor writes these manifests — capture spawn/hotspots from the camera, tap to place props and ambience, then Download or Publish (POST /v1/experience → ingest/exp-<id>.verse.json + share link). Manifests publish with root-relative URLs so they resolve from ingest/. The Scenes section authors scenes directly: add streamed .vpk objects at x/y/z/yaw/scale offsets with immediate additive preview; the base scene becomes entry 0 on export, and removing a scene — like removing a prop — re-previews on reload. 📸 Poster captures the viewport and publishes it (POST /v1/poster → ingest/poster-<id>.png) for the embed's data-poster.

Auto-staging: ingest scenes compiled with a walk-collision grid ship ingest/<id>.stage.json (a compiler-picked spawn in exactly this manifest's format, plus a 20–60 s auto tour in the /v1/tour sample format, planned through free space on the collision grid for interiors) and ingest/<id>.plan.svg (a deterministic floor plan the minimap uses as its base layer) — see docs/api.md. The ?edit=1 editor seeds its draft spawn from the stage manifest and shows "Auto-staged ✓"; an explicit spawn here always wins over the auto one.

Not yet: gizmo manipulation of placed items and scenes (offsets are numeric); walk grids of SCALED scene placements (translation + yaw grids contribute; scale sits out of collision).
